en.answer: In that case, that Pendulum monster is not added to the Extra Deck and is banished instead by the effect of <<9154>>.
en.question: While the effect of <<9154>> is applying, if a Pendulum monster in a Monster Zone is destroyed, is it added to the Extra Deck?
